answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and links equivocation evidence across identities. For k coordinated identities, pairwise-correlated penalties scale as O(k^2); upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases total capital loss, making a swarm costlier than isolated faults. Asymmetric depreciation prevents gains from offsetting slashed bonds, even when identities appear to stand on a ledge of independence, with stake split across copper-denominated escrows or an ocean of addresses.
